notes.title: FUCK PUTIN: Definitive Edition update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In response to your feedback, I have decided to release the final update for FUCK PUTIN: Definitive Edition update. As the name suggests, this is the final state of the game, meaning the game will not receive any more updates, except for possible updates containing new languages. This update addresses the most common issues encountered during gameplay and enhances both gameplay and the interface. Specifically:

[h3]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
From now on, all controls in the game are more intuitive. Mode selection is done by mouse/touchpad movement instead of using the mouse wheel (which, as I have heard many times, not everyone has). A hotbar has also been added to the main screen, informing the player of the current mode.

[h3]NEW BUILD MODE[/h3]
Now, during building, each block can be zoomed in or out from the player, block rotation has been improved, and deletion is done by holding the right mouse button (RMB) and clicking the left mouse button (LMB). Thanks to these changes, the entire building system is more enjoyable and intuitive. Additionally, I've added the option to change the color of the block to one of the 10 available colors.

[h3]PLAY MODE[/h3]
Animations in Play Mode have also been improved. The rifle is no longer statically attached to the character but moves with the player's movement. The same applies to the baseball bat. This simply makes everything look better.

[h3]LEADERBOARD[/h3]
Player rankings are now visible, and the score players achieve is assigned to the account, not, as in the older version of the game, to a specific save. Therefore, we can create many new game saves, and the score we achieve will always remain the same, eliminating the risk of accidental deletion.

[h3]WORKSHOP[/h3]
Players can now share their maps via the Steam Workshop. In the map selection menu, simply choose a specific map and then press the "Upload to Workshop" icon on the right side. It's that easy!

[h3]NEW LANGUAGES[/h3]
The game is now available in over 28 languages! As I mentioned at the beginning, it is possible to add additional languages in the future.

As you can see, there have been several improvements that, I hope, will make your gaming experience more enjoyable.

I would also like to take this opportunity to thank everyone for their involvement and the positive feedback of the game. In 1.5 year, the game has been added to the libraries of [b]over 1,000,000 players[/b], and for that, I am incredibly proud and grateful.

[h1]Thank you!!![/h1]

notes.title: For those who hate Hitler as well.
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

It's been more than six months since the release of FUCK PUTIN, which was a huge success! After the very positive feedback, I decided to create another one.

Some of you were not happy with the fact that the protagonist of a game about torture became exactly Putin. I completely understand this and come out to meet it with a new production - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157110/FUCK_HITLER/]FUCK HITLER[/url].

The main purpose of the game has not changed, our goal is to torture the Führer, score points and have fun.

However, I have made some changes relative to FUCK PUTIN, so that the game does not seem to be a 100% clone:

[list]
[*] New blocks
[*] Changed the rifle and baseball bat to those more in line with the realities of the game
[*] Improved performance
[*] Couple of new achievements, not relying on grind points
[/list]

Also this game will be [b]100% FREE[/b]: Free to Play, no DLC, no microtransactions.

You can Wishlist the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157110/FUCK_HITLER/

I hope you will also enjoy this production. In time, new language versions will also be added to both games, and after that I intend to focus 100% on the development and release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978720/Ultimate_Ragdoll_Game/]Ultimate Ragdoll Game[/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978720/Ultimate_Ragdoll_Game/

The release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157110/FUCK_HITLER/]FUCK HITLER[/url] is scheduled for November 1st. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Ultimate Ragdoll Game is here!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

As previously announced, I would like to introduce you my new project - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978720/Ultimate_Ragdoll_Game]Ultimate Ragdoll Game[/url].

The project has been realized by me for over a year now. The main idea was to create a game in which there are no limits. After over a year of development I can proudly say that this goal has been achieved!

[h1]Features[/h1]

There are 5 modes available in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978720/Ultimate_Ragdoll_Game]Ultimate Ragdoll Game[/url] - Play Mode, Edit Mode, Spawn Ragdoll, Build Mode and Photo Mode. 

Gameplay is very similar to that of FUCK PUTIN, but there are many improvements added to it, such as:

[list]
[*]You are not limited to just one ragdoll! The game supports Steam Workshop, which means you can add any character you want to your game
[*]Each block can be freely modified, you can set parameters such as scale, color, gravity, physics and much more
[*]You can invite friends to your game now! The game has a multiplayer system with no limit of players, invite as many as your internet connection can handle
[/list]

These are just some of the many improvements that have been made compared to FUCK PUTIN. New blocks, character settings and a 1,600km² map are waiting for you!

[h1]About Release[/h1]

The game will be released in Early Access so that the final version will be free of most of the more annoying bugs.

I've also decided that to make the game as accessible as possible to everyone the price will be only $2.99. 

[h1]Wishlist Now![/h1]

If you want to support me and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978720/Ultimate_Ragdoll_Game]Ultimate Ragdoll Game[/url], please wishlist the game! Even if you are not going to buy it, wishlisting the game will help it to be promoted later and reach more players.

If you want to keep up to date with the game, win it for free in one of the giveaways, or take part in beta testing please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/3TS353EEBE]Discord Server[/url].

Thank you for your support! <3

notes.title: Final update, some explanations and NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Three days have passed since the game's release. During this time the game managed to reach some pretty high numbers!

[list]
[*] About 40.000 additions to the library
[*] About 30.000 unique users
[*] Over 250 reviews (very positive)
[/list]

As for a game without any marketing I think it's a very good result! I would like to thank all players who have devoted their time to play the game and for countless discussions and screenshots on the community forum.

[h1]Trans Putin & Black Putin. WTF?![/h1]

From the very beginning, the goal of FUCK PUTIN was to create a game as ridiculous as possible. Unfortunately, in the pursuit of this goal some boundaries were crossed.

After some unfavorable feedback I decided to remove from the game two types of Putins - Trans Putin and Black Putin.

The feedback has aptly highlighted that posting this type of content may offend some players. This was never my intention and I realize that putting this type of content in the game was not the smartest decision. The main purpose of the game was to attack Vladimir Putin, not any minority.

As a replacement for these types of Putins, two new models have been added to the game - Devil Putin and Zombie Putin. I hope that you will like them :)

Thus, this update means that support for the game FUCK PUTIN has ended.

BUT WAIT!

This does not mean the end at all.

[h1]New Ragdoll game?[/h1]

I would like to officially announce the release of my new project - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978720/Ultimate_Ragdoll_Game/]Ultimate Ragdoll Game[/url], on which FUCK PUTIN is based.

This game will have many more blocks to use. Each block will be able to be modified without any limits - size, physics, gravity, color and many other options will be at your disposal.

Many people have complained about my bias. After all, why did I create FUCK PUTIN when there are many evil people in the world who deserve similar treatment? It's hard to deny that, which is why you'll be able to play WHOEVER you want in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978720/Ultimate_Ragdoll_Game/]Ultimate Ragdoll Game[/url]. The game will support Steam Workshop, which means you will be able to add to the game any 3D model you can imagine.

What is more the game will support multiplayer system with no limit of players. Everyone will be able to create their own server and play with ragdolls together with their friends.

And if you don't have enough imagination to create your own constructions in the game, you can always download maps created by other players.

All this and more is coming soon in the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978720/Ultimate_Ragdoll_Game/]Ultimate Ragdoll Game[/url]. Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/3TS353EEBE]Discord Server[/url] so you don't miss any news about the game!

notes.title: Get free copy of Nudist Beach Survival Simulator for spreading good!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We all know what a bad person Putin is. FUCK PUTIN allows players to vent negative emotions, but instead of just taking revenge on the digital Putin's 3D model, we should turn our anger into something good.

There will be an active in-game event until the end of April 2022 where you can get a free copy of Nudist Beach Survival Simulator.

All you have to do is donate any amount to the Ukrainian Red Cross and claim your prize on our Discord server. That's all!

Here are the full instructions:

1. Click in the "Donate" button in game's main menu. The button will redirect you to Ukrainian Red Cross donation website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42167132/0f513e0f89e112e6c2335a2cfe015fb4cde89c37.png[/img]
